description: Get ability details by name or numeric ID — full English effect text, short effect text, generation introduced, and the list of Pokémon that have the ability (including hidden-ability flag and slot). Ability names are returned by pokeapi_get_pokemon in the abilities array.

identifier.description: Ability name in lowercase hyphenated form (e.g. "overgrow", "speed-boost") or numeric ID as a string.

name: pokeapi_get_ability

effectText.description: Full English effect description. Null when unavailable.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The identifier resolves to no ability in PokéAPI. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

generation.description: Generation in which the ability was introduced.

items.description: Pokémon entry with ability slot and hidden-ability flag.

isHidden.description: True when this is the hidden ability for the Pokémon.

shortEffectText.description: Short English effect summary. Null when unavailable.

title: Get Ability
